high_level_description: A golden retriever running along a wet sandy beach at sunset, spray flying from its paws, low camera angle.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Wide beach at low tide with the sea on the right, orange and pink sunset sky with thin clouds, wet sand reflecting the sky.

elements.desc: Golden retriever mid-stride with its ears flapping and mouth open, wet fur on its legs, running toward the camera.
Small waves breaking in white foam along the right edge of the frame.
